name: Sakata Yukie
source:
The proprietress of Sakata Ryokan in Yatara Hot Spring Village. She is Junpei's aunt and Kanoko's mother.

Since her husband's death, she has been running the inn on her own. She is famous among the locals as a beautiful widow proprietress.

She has a nice body that looks good in kimono. She sometimes offers special services to young male guests (who rarely come to the inn). This time, she decides to teach Akira some adult charms in a relaxed manner.

In fact, she is the partner of Junpei's first experience!!.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bokunatsu.html]official site[/url]]
